[SWS_DM_00223] Handling of ’warningIndicatorRequested’ bit
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04204
⌈
If a DTC status confirmedDTC bit is set from 0 to 1, the DM shall set the "WarningIndi-
catorRequested" bit to 1 and set the healing counter to 0.
⌋
For confirmation check [SWS_DM_00218].
